shellCommands.command: pwd && printf '%s\n' '--- files ---' && rg --files | sort | sed -n '1,160p' && printf '%s\n' '--- status ---' && git status --short

printf '%s
' '--- workspace ---'; find . -maxdepth 2 -type f | sort | sed -n '1,200p'; printf '%s
' '--- directories ---'; find . -maxdepth 2 -type d | sort; printf '%s
' '--- status ---'; git status --short

printf '%s\n' '--- command files ---'; find src/commands -maxdepth 2 -type f -print | sort; printf '%s\n' '--- relevant symbols ---'; grep -RInE 'format_duration|Date|since|until|Entry|entry|Command|ApiClient' src/commands src/arguments.rs src/main.rs src/utilities.rs src/models.rs src/api | head -300

sed -n '1,280p' src/arguments.rs; printf '%s
' '--- main ---'; sed -n '1,280p' src/main.rs; printf '%s
' '--- mod ---'; sed -n '1,240p' src/commands/mod.rs; printf '%s
' '--- utilities ---'; sed -n '1,280p' src/utilities.rs

sed -n '280,620p' src/utilities.rs; printf '%s
' '--- args entry/report/search locations ---'; grep -nE '^    (Entry|Report)|pub enum (EntryAction|ReportAction)|Stats|since:|until:' src/arguments.rs; printf '%s
' '--- main entry dispatch remainder ---'; sed -n '240,520p' src/main.rs; printf '%s
' '--- list ---'; sed -n '1,300p' src/commands/list.rs; printf '%s
' '--- report ---'; sed -n '1,360p' src/commands/report.rs; printf '%s
' '--- search ---'; sed -n '1,320p' src/commands/search.rs

sed -n '300,390p' src/arguments.rs; sed -n '620,735p' src/arguments.rs; sed -n '820,930p' src/arguments.rs; printf '%s\n' '--- api client ---'; sed -n '1,320p' src/api/client.rs; printf '%s\n' '--- models ---'; sed -n '1,300p' src/models.rs

sed -n '300,470p' src/models.rs; grep -nE 'impl ApiClient|fn get_time_entries_filtered|network_time_entry' src/api/client.rs; sed -n '620,810p' src/api/client.rs; grep -RIn 'format_duration_hms' src tests; grep -RIn 'get_time_entries_filtered' src/commands src/api | head -80

sed -n '370,490p' src/api/client.rs; sed -n '1230,1515p' src/api/client.rs; sed -n '735,820p' src/arguments.rs; sed -n '930,1030p' src/arguments.rs; sed -n '500,555p' src/commands/report.rs; sed -n '1,140p' Cargo.toml
sed -n '400,525p' src/commands/list.rs; sed -n '1,120p' src/commands/test_utils.rs; sed -n '1030,1110p' src/arguments.rs; grep -n 'fn get_entities' src/api/client.rs
grep -n '^use commands\|EntryAction::BulkEdit\|Command::Report\|Available commands' src/main.rs; grep -n '^pub enum EntryAction\|^pub enum ReportAction\|impl Command' src/arguments.rs
sed -n '717,790p' src/arguments.rs
grep -RIn 'NO_PROJECT\|No Project' src; grep -n 'EntryAction::' src/arguments.rs | tail -30
cargo fmt --check
cargo fmt
cargo test
cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
cargo run --quiet -- entry stats --help
tail -45 src/utilities.rs
cargo fmt --check && cargo test --bin toggl
cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat
cargo fmt && cargo fmt --check && cargo test --bin toggl && git diff --check && git status --short
